scope: Read-only semantic audit of revision 0.5.1 digital-candidate-r4 against the user's corrected water and transit requirements.

berlin_snapshot.coverage_limit: Berlin-area snapshot only; it does not cover the complete context_outline extent.

tegeler_see.name: Tegeler See
tegeler_see.conclusion: The feature is present, large enough to print as a deliberate opening in both modes, and was lost before raster/CAD generation.

transit_selection.s_bahn: multilinestring relation with route=light_rail and network:metro=s-bahn
transit_selection.u_bahn: multilinestring relation with route=subway and network:metro=u-bahn

current_pipeline_findings.evidence: source/v0.4.0/berlin/extract_context_source.py reads only the OSM lines layer and filters waterway IN ('river','canal'); no multipolygon water layer exists in source-data/v0.4.0/berlin.
source/v0.4.0/berlin/build_berlin_modes.py derives apertures only from waterways.geojson; therefore lakes such as Tegeler See can never reach the opening mask.
roads-accent.geojson is filtered from motorway, motorway_link, trunk and trunk_link and feeds the tool-4 mask.
Revision 0.5.1 digital-candidate-r4 is geometrically valid but semantically superseded; it cannot be released or printed as the corrected Berlin map.

approved_target_semantics.tool_3: street network including motorway/trunk, with no separate blue motorway accent
approved_target_semantics.tool_4: S-Bahn and U-Bahn route network, Berlin context boundary, and parameterized site marker
approved_target_semantics.negative_geometry: All mapped water areas plus river/canal/stream centerlines that survive the declared physical aperture thresholds and protected keep-outs.

required_next_evidence: Human approval of the revision 0.5.2 concept showing complete water openings and blue S/U-Bahn routes.
A new immutable context-complete source derivative containing water multipolygons, river/canal/stream lines, and S/U-Bahn route relations.
A machine-readable coverage report proving Tegeler See reaches the final aperture mask with nonzero area in both modes.
An omission report for source water features below manufacturing thresholds or removed by structural keep-outs; named printable water bodies must not disappear silently.
Revalidation of retained-body connectivity, open-area ratio, minimum ligaments, four tool bodies, composites, native 3MF geometry, and exact Anycubic slices.
